items.t: Why Colgate-Palmolive (CL) Is Getting Fresh Attention Now
items.sum: BofA Securities recently flagged Colgate-Palmolive (CL) as a top pick in US consumer staples for 2027, citing US market share gains, margin expansion, and steady emerging markets performance as key drivers of renewed investor attention. items.t: PG vs. CL: value, quality, and pair-trade setup compared
items.sum: Investing.com -- Neither stock is cheap, and the two come out roughly even on value. Both trade above fair value estimates. Colgate-Palmolive (CL) looks better on cash yield, growth and returns. Procter & Gamble (PG) looks better on forward P/E and dividend. All figures are as of Nov 23, 2026, 3:44 PM EST unless dated otherwise.

items.t: 2027 oil price forecast: Where BofA thinks Brent is headed next
items.sum: Investing.com -- Bank of America kept its forecast for Brent crude at an average of $80 a barrel in 2027, telling investors in a note that geopolitics will remain the main driver of oil prices.

items.t: Oil set for first weekly gain in November as Gulf attacks threaten supply recovery
items.sum: Investing.com -- Oil prices were mixed on Friday but remained on track for their first weekly gain this month, as renewed attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure and commercial vessels around the Strait of Hormuz heightened concerns that escalating hostilities could undermine the recovery in regional crude shipments.

items.t: Europe gas prices rangebound as markets weigh Middle East tensions
items.sum: Investing.com - European wholesale natural gas prices traded mixed to higher on Thursday, as energy desks balanced lingering supply relief against a sharp escalation in Middle Eastern hostilities that pushed crude oil higher.

items.t: Oil little changed as Hormuz attacks threaten rebound in Gulf crude shipments
items.sum: Investing.com -- Oil prices were little changed in Asian trading on Thursday as renewed attacks on tankers and Saudi energy infrastructure threatened to undermine the recovery in Middle Eastern crude shipments, while rising U.S. inventories and expectations of a global supply surplus limited gains.
